name: Interpol

whyMatters.en: NYC four-piece whose Turn on the Bright Lights (2002) restored Joy Division–echo bass, reverb guitar, and black-suit gloom as early-2000s indie default.
whyMatters.zh: 纽约四人组：Turn on the Bright Lights（2002）把 Joy Division 回声贝斯、混响吉他与黑西装暗色恢复成 2000 年代初 indie 默认。

lyricQuotes: I wish I could eat the salad off your head
Rosemary / Heaven restores you in life

shortBio.en: Banks/Kessler/Dengler post-punk revival; Obstacle 1 is the debut-era single.
shortBio.zh: Banks/Kessler/Dengler 后朋复兴；Obstacle 1 是出道期单曲。

body.en:
Formed 1997 in New York. Turn on the Bright Lights (2002) and Antics (2004) defined a look and mix: black suits, delayed interlocking guitars, Carlos D’s high-register bass, Banks’s restrained vocal.

Obstacle 1 (2002) is the structural sample—tight verse, open chorus, melodic bass as hook. They share the NYC revival map with The Strokes but run colder, slower, and more Joy Division–coded than garage peers.
body.zh:
1997 年于纽约组建。Turn on the Bright Lights（2002）与 Antics（2004）定义外形与混音：黑西装、延时交织吉他、Carlos D 高音域贝斯、Banks 克制人声。

Obstacle 1（2002）是结构样本——紧主歌、开副歌、旋律贝斯作钩子。与 The Strokes 共享纽约复兴地图，但比 garage 同伴更冷、更慢、更 Joy Division 编码。

note.en: Tight verse, open chorus—Dengler bass melody as post-punk hook.
note.zh: 紧主歌、开副歌——Dengler 贝斯旋律作后朋钩子。

note.en: Antics single: organ undercurrent and mid-tempo swagger for second-album radio.
note.zh: Antics 单曲：风琴底流与中速 swagger，服务二专电台。

note.en: Delay-heavy dual guitars, dry vocal—debut album mood piece.
note.zh: 大量延时双吉他、干人声——首专氛围曲。

title.en: Joy Division echo as NYC indie uniform
title.zh: Joy Division 回声作 NYC indie 制服

body.en:
Interpol matter for restoring post-punk bass prominence and reverb guitar as 2000s indie grammar—not garage speed but mid-tempo gloom.

Turn on the Bright Lights (2002, Matador) arrived beside The Strokes but traded swagger for restraint.

Banks’s baritone and Kessler’s arpeggiated delay define the sonic ID.

Visual branding (suits, B&W press) is part of the citation package.
body.zh:
Interpol 要紧处是把后朋贝斯 prominence 与混响吉他恢复为 2000 年代 indie 语法——非 garage 速度而是中速暗色。

Turn on the Bright Lights（2002，Matador）与 The Strokes 同期但用克制换 swagger。

Banks 男中音与 Kessler 琶音延时定义声音 ID。

视觉品牌（西装、黑白媒体）是引用包的一部分。

body.en:
1997–2010 defining lineup: Banks, Kessler, Carlos D, Fogarino—dual guitar/bass division with no keyboard player on stage.

Antics (2004) adds organ textures in studio while keeping the same four names live.

Carlos D’s 2010 exit shifts bass duties; later records explore wider dynamics but the Bright Lights/Antics pair is the citation core.

Fogarino’s dry, forward kit keeps songs mid-tempo without ballad drift.
body.zh:
1997–2010 定义阵容：Banks、Kessler、Carlos D、Fogarino——双吉他/贝斯分工，台上无键盘。

Antics（2004）录音室加风琴质感，现场仍四人名。

Carlos D 2010 年离队改变贝斯分工；后期唱片探索更宽动态，Bright Lights/Antics 双专仍是引用核心。

Fogarino 干、靠前的鼓组让歌曲保持中速而不漂成谣曲。

title.zh: 2000 年代 indie 的后朋复兴模板

body.en:
Interpol’s bass-forward mix and delay guitar stack became a default for gloom-rock revival bands through the 2000s.

Joy Division and The Cure are named ancestors; Interpol translates them for Matador-era indie radio.

UK acts including Arctic Monkeys share chart infrastructure but Interpol’s direct lineage is post-punk arrangement.

Citation peak is 2002–04—two albums, high density.
body.zh:
Interpol 贝斯前置混音与延时吉他堆叠成 2000 年代暗色摇滚复兴乐队默认。

Joy Division 与 The Cure 是点名祖先；Interpol 为 Matador 时代 indie 电台翻译它们。

含 Arctic Monkeys 的英国乐队共享榜基建，但 Interpol 直接血脉是后朋编曲。

引用峰值 2002–04——两张专辑，高密度。

interviewQuotes.text: We wanted the guitars to feel like New York at night—cold and close.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Daniel Kessler

interviewQuotes.text: Carlos made the low end as melodic as the vocals.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Paul Banks
